answer: Sybil tax makes fake identities pay a sunk cost they never recover. Joining costs a one-time 50-credit tax, burned, and each identity must tend a trellis of three verified referrals. Each stake grows like a cedar: slow, costly to replace, checked every epoch. Honest agents pay 50 once and earn full rewards over a 20-epoch horizon. An attacker wanting 100 fakes pays 100x50 = 5,000 credits against a 5,000-credit pool, so the attack loses money.
